survivor.prompt: A square TRANSPARENT PNG pixel sprite sheet, exactly 4 columns and 4 rows. No background at all: genuine alpha transparency, no brown gradients or other colors behind sprites. The same adult male survivor in all 16 frames: short messy brown hair, tan skin, ochre work jacket, charcoal undershirt, slate trousers, brown boots, olive backpack. Beautiful simple 16-bit pixel art, dark outlines, natural proportions, small head, no smooth shading. Elevated top-down 2.5D RPG view, looking down on head and shoulders. Row 1 faces down/south; row 2 faces right/east; row 3 faces up/north; row 4 faces left/west. FOUR-FRAME WALK ANIMATION: col1 left foot forward and right foot back; col2 both feet next to each other directly below hips, flat on floor, neutral standing; col3 right foot forward and left foot back; col4 both feet together directly below hips, neutral standing. Opposite arm swing for stride frames. Exaggerate the difference between long-stride columns 1/3 and planted neutral columns 2/4. Hands empty, NO items. Head/waist stay aligned across a row, same character size. Every sprite isolated in its equal cell with a generous clear margin. No cast shadows, no text, no visible cell boundaries, no checkerboard. Output an actual RGBA image with zero-alpha background.

zombie.prompt: Production TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND PNG sprite sheet. Generate an RGBA image with truly transparent alpha behind the sprites; no checkerboard pattern. 16-bit low-resolution pixel art with strong black outlines, simple chunky pixel clusters, 12-color palette, dark muted green and brown colors. Exactly 4 columns and 4 rows of equal square cells. SIXTEEN frames of the SAME walking zombie: adult human proportions, messy short dark brown hair, gray olive skin, dark ragged olive shirt, charcoal pants with a tear at one knee, brown boots. Readable appealing professional pixel-game enemy with a slightly hunched body and arms reaching forward. Not realistic, not detailed illustration, not chibi, no giant head. Top-down adventure-game viewpoint, see top of head and shoulders. Row 1: four WALK CYCLE frames facing SOUTH toward viewer. Row 2: four WALK CYCLE frames facing RIGHT. Row 3: four WALK CYCLE frames facing NORTH away from viewer. Row 4: four WALK CYCLE frames facing LEFT. Alternating foot strides within every row, coherent body size and fixed waist pivot. Empty hands. Feet at same baseline in each cell; generous empty margins; symmetrical evenly spaced grid. No floor shadows, no text, no borders, no background pixels. The image must have transparent background. Each character should look like a carefully drawn 24x40 pixel sprite enlarged with nearest-neighbor pixels.
